chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 324 – The Reunion: Ji Ning Saves Yu Wei with Starseizing Hand
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning reunites with Yu Wei in the Brightmoon Mountains-and-Waters Painting, crushing their enemies. But Lu Dongbin notices something deeper in Yu Wei’s eyes—and Nine Lotos watches with a heavy heart.
og_description: Ji Ning saves Yu Wei in a devastating display of power. Lu Dongbin spots hidden feelings. Nine Lotos struggles with hers.
twitter_title: Reunion! Ji Ning + Yu Wei | Lu Dongbin playing matchmaker
twitter_description: Ji Ning crushes the Celestial Silkworm Sect and reunites with Yu Wei. The Pure Yang True Immortals gossip, and Nine Lotos watches with complicated feelings.

lore_anchors.definition: A divine sense secret art that manifests the practitioner’s thoughts into spiritual soldiers, directly attacking an enemy’s soul and causing momentary unconsciousness.
One of the top ten divine abilities of the Three Realms, created by Daoist Threelives; it transforms the user’s hands into weapons of terrifying power, capable of crushing stars.
A Pure Yang treasure used for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly trials; it contains a vast landscape where participants compete for token talismans.
The highest cultivation realm in the Three Realms, above Celestial Immortal; those who achieve this are among the most powerful beings in existence.
One of the legendary Eight Immortals in Chinese folklore; in Desolate Era, he is a Pure Yang True Immortal known for his sword arts and his love of playing matchmaker.
A talented female cultivator from the Dongyan clan, former companion of Ji Ning at the Black-White College; she has deep, unresolved feelings for him.
A grand tournament held once every three centuries by the Grand Xia Dynasty to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts from across the realm.
A key item collected within the Brightmoon Mountains-and-Waters Painting; abandoning all tokens allows teleportation out, but the process has a brief delay.
Two complete Dao-based spells used by Yu Wei, representing mastery over elemental ice and fire at the Dao level.
